stories.title: Game 2 Recap — Bregman Walk-off, 13 Wrigley Walk-offs
stories.angle: Alex Bregman walk-off single in 9th gave Cubs a 4-3 win (score omitted per insight) over White Sox in Game 2. Gausman exited in 4.3 IP with left-hand cramp (glove hand). Rain delay ~90 min after top of 8th. Bregman delivered anyway. This is the Cubs' 13th walk-off win at Wrigley Field this season, leading all of MLB.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Alex Bregman. One out. Ninth inning. Walkoff single.

Gausman left early, rain delayed 90 minutes, White Sox tied it up — and Bregman still ended it. That's the 2026 Cubs: 13 Wrigley walk-offs this season, leading MLB.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Wrigley Walk-off Culture — 13 Leading MLB
stories.angle: The 2026 Cubs have 13 walk-off wins at Wrigley Field — more than any other MLB team. Bold take on the lineup's clutch identity: this isn't luck, it's a roster built to punish one bad pitch.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
13 walk-off wins at Wrigley Field this season.

No other team in baseball has more. This isn't luck — it's a lineup built to punish one bad pitch. The 2026 Cubs know exactly who they are: they don't fold, they walk it off.

#Cubs #FlyTheW #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Gausman Injury Update — Glove Hand, Next Start Expected
stories.angle: Kevin Gausman's exit from Game 2 was due to a LEFT HAND cramp — his glove hand, not his throwing hand. Not expected to go on IL. Cubs expect him to make his next start. He's still adjusting after the deadline acquisition (three Cubs outings so far).

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Update on Kevin Gausman: left hand cramp — his glove hand, not his throwing hand.

Expected to make his next start. Still finding his footing through three Cubs outings, but the arm is fine. That's all that matters heading into October.

#Cubs #MLB #CubsBaseball

stories.title: NL Standings + Cardinals Jab — Cubs WC1, Cards 13.5 Back
stories.angle: Cardinals sit 13.5 games back in the NL Central (Brewers 77-48, Cards 64-62). Cubs are No. 1 Wild Card, just 4 back of Milwaukee with 7 head-to-head Brewers games remaining. Rival jab + playoff context in one tweet.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Cardinals sit 13.5 games back in the NL Central and St. Louis fans know it.

Meanwhile, Cubs are No. 1 Wild Card and just 4 back of Milwaukee — with 7 Brewers games left on the schedule. September is about to get interesting.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Game 3 Preview — Sweep Hunt at Wrigley, 1:20 PM CT
stories.angle: Cubs 2-0, going for the Crosstown sweep. Sean Newcomb (LHP) starts for the Cubs; Clay Holmes (RHP, 5-5, 2.56 ERA) for the White Sox. First pitch 1:20 PM CT at Wrigley Field. Back-to-back walk-off nights deserve an emphatic afternoon finish.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Sweep time. 1:20 PM CT at Wrigley Field.

Newcomb on the bump for the Cubs, Holmes for the White Sox. Chicago's already won the series — now it's about dominance. Back-to-back walk-off nights deserve one emphatic afternoon finish.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
